name: Zozo Portfolio for Elementor
author: zozothemes

sections.description:
Zozo Portfolio for Elementor is a powerful portfolio plugin that allows you to create portfolio grids, masonry layouts, portfolio sliders, AJAX filterable galleries and interactive portfolio showcases using Elementor.

This Elementor portfolio plugin helps you build portfolio grid layouts, masonry galleries, portfolio sliders, portfolio filters and modern hover effects directly inside the Elementor page builder.

Create beautiful portfolio grids, masonry layouts, sliders, galleries, video showcases and advanced hover interactions — all inside Elementor.

The plugin is built with performance, flexibility and design freedom in mind. Perfect for agencies, designers, developers, photographers and video creators.

Live Demo
Documentation

Why Choose Zozo Portfolio?

✔ Elementor portfolio grid layouts
✔ AJAX portfolio filtering
✔ Masonry portfolio galleries
✔ Portfolio slider and carousel layouts
✔ Portfolio video galleries
✔ Advanced hover animations
✔ Custom fields for portfolio projects
✔ Fully responsive and RTL ready

Zozo Portfolio is designed as a lightweight Elementor portfolio plugin focusing purely on portfolio creation without adding unnecessary Elementor widgets.

Perfect Alternative To Heavy Portfolio Plugins

Zozo Portfolio provides a lightweight alternative to large Elementor addon plugins.
Instead of installing huge Elementor addon packages, this plugin focuses specifically on portfolio grids, portfolio galleries and portfolio sliders while maintaining excellent performance.

Portfolio Layouts

Create visually engaging portfolio layouts with full Elementor customization.

  • Portfolio Grid

Display portfolio items in structured responsive grid layouts with flexible columns and spacing.

Demos

Portfolio 2 Column
Portfolio 3 Column
Portfolio 4 Column
Portfolio Fullwidth Grid

  • Portfolio List & List Slider

Display portfolio items in storytelling layouts ideal for case studies and project highlights.

Supports 2, 3 and 4 column layouts and slider format.

Demos

Portfolio List
Portfolio List Slider

  • Portfolio Masonry

Create modern masonry layouts that dynamically adjust item height for visually appealing galleries.

Supports filtering, gutters and fullwidth layouts.

Demos

Masonry 2 Column
Masonry 3 Column
Masonry 4 Column
Masonry Fullwidth

Advanced Sliders & Effects

Bring motion and interaction to your portfolio presentations.

  • Portfolio Slider
    Showcase portfolio items in a smooth, touch-friendly slider with full Elementor control. Ideal for highlighting featured projects, case studies, or homepage showcases with responsive navigation and performance-optimized transitions.
    Demo:
    Portfolio Slider

  • Slider Center Mode
    Emphasize your active portfolio item by placing it in the center while surrounding slides appear partially visible. This layout is perfect for modern, interactive presentations and draws attention to key projects without overwhelming the viewer.
    Demo:
    Portfolio Slider Center

  • CoverFlow, Cube, Fade, Flip Effects
    Add cinematic motion to your portfolio sliders using advanced transition effects. Choose from CoverFlow, Cube, Fade, or Flip animations to create immersive visual experiences that feel premium and engaging across all devices.
    Demos:
    Portfolio Carousel CoverFlow
    Portfolio Carousel Cube
    Portfolio Carousel Fade
    Portfolio Carousel Flip

  • Portfolio Pagination & AJAX Load More
    Control how users browse your portfolio with classic pagination, AJAX load more, or infinite scrolling. Content loads dynamically without page refresh, improving user experience and keeping visitors engaged longer.
    Demos:
    Portfolio with Pagination
    Portfolio with AJAX Load More
    Portfolio with Infinite Scroll

  • Gallery Variations
    Create visually rich image galleries with flexible layout options designed for speed and responsiveness. Each gallery adapts seamlessly to different screen sizes while maintaining sharp visuals and smooth interactions.
    Demos:
    Default Gallery
    Grid Gallery
    Masonry Gallery
    360° Image Viewer

  • Video Portfolio Layouts
    Designed for video-first portfolios, these layouts help you present motion content in a clean, engaging, and professional way. Ideal for filmmakers, agencies, content creators, and marketing teams.
    Demos:
    Fullwidth Video
    Tilt Video
    Video Slider
    Video Slider Center
    Video Flip
    Video Cube
    Video Coverflow
    Video List Video

  • Hover & Interaction Styles
    Enhance user engagement with modern hover effects that reveal project details without cluttering the layout. Designed to feel smooth, lightweight, and visually appealing.
    Demos:
    Mouse Hover
    Mouse Hover Light
    Overlay Effects
    Portfolio Tilt

RTL Support

Zozo Portfolio is fully optimized for Right-to-Left languages…

Demos:

  • Portfolio Grid RTL
  • Portfolio List RTL
  • Masonry Filter RTL
  • Portfolio Slider RTL
  • Pagination RTL

Advanced Portfolio Layouts (New)

Zozo Portfolio now includes advanced modern portfolio presentation styles designed to create highly interactive experiences.

  • Portfolio Cobbles

Create visually dynamic layouts where portfolio items combine in various sizes to create unique presentation patterns.

Demo:
Portfolio Cobbles

  • Portfolio Marquee

Add horizontal scrolling portfolio sections similar to modern design agency websites.

Demo:
Portfolio Marquee

  • Portfolio Inertia

Introduce smooth inertia scrolling effects where portfolio items move with natural motion for immersive interaction.

Demo:
Portfolio Inertia

  • Portfolio Directional Hover

Display hover effects based on cursor direction for modern interactive portfolio displays.

Demo:
Portfolio Directional Hover

  • Portfolio Scroll Stack

Stack portfolio items vertically and animate them while scrolling to create storytelling layouts.

Demo:
Portfolio Scroll Stack

These layouts are perfect for creative agencies and modern portfolio websites.

Portfolio Custom Fields (NEW)

Zozo Portfolio includes custom fields support for portfolio items.

Supported field types:

✔ Text
✔ Select
✔ Checkbox
✔ Radio
✔ Image

These fields allow users to add project information such as:

• Client name
• Project date
• Technologies used
• Project URL

Key Features at a Glance

✔ Custom Post Type for Portfolios
✔ Portfolio Categories & Tags
✔ Elementor Widgets (Grid, Masonry, Slider, List, Filter)
✔ AJAX Filtering, Load More & Infinite Scroll
✔ Portfolio Custom Fields
✔ Advanced Portfolio Layouts
✔ 360° Image Viewer
✔ Lightbox Integration
✔ Responsive Design
✔ RTL Ready
✔ Theme Independent

Perfect For

✔ Creative agencies
✔ Web designers
✔ Photographers
✔ Videographers
✔ Developers building portfolio websites

sections.installation:
1. Upload the zozo-portfolio folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated
  4. Create portfolio items from the Portfolio menu
  5. Add portfolio widgets using Elementor
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. The portfolio widgets are built for Elementor.

Can I customize templates?

Yes. Templates can be overridden using:

your-theme/zozo-portfolio/

Does it work with any theme?

Yes, it works with all modern WordPress themes.

Does the plugin support AJAX filtering?

Yes. AJAX filtering, pagination and infinite scroll are supported.
